title: design-kit.config.json
description: Version 1 of the @codepress/design-kit configuration. Paths are relative to the folder that holds the config file.

$schema.description: The schema an editor validates this file against.

out.description: Where captures write the kit when --out is not given.

items.description: A folder or file, relative to the repository root (not to this file): no leading slash, no .., no glob.

watch.description: The paths whose change rebuilds the kit in CI (`design-kit ci-check`), relative to the repository root. A run where none of them changed since the newest kit's commit builds nothing. Without it, any change in the repository rebuilds. `init` writes the Storybook and app folders, the workspace packages they use, global styles, this file, the lockfile and the workflow.

storage.description: Where the kit is stored. Without it, "github": a GitHub Actions artifact. Older versions of the package reject this key, so bump the pinned version (DESIGN_KIT_PACKAGE in the workflow) when you add it by hand.

type.description: "github" (default): a GitHub Actions artifact. "codepress": CodePress keeps the newest kit of each branch; the workflow signs in with its GitHub OIDC token. "s3": your own AWS S3 bucket. "r2": your own Cloudflare R2 bucket.

url.description: codepress: the CodePress address, which is also the upload token's audience. Default https://codepress.dev.

apiUrl.description: codepress: the CodePress API base. Default https://api.codepress.dev/v1 for the default url, else <url>/v1.

bucket.description: s3 and r2: the bucket's name.

prefix.description: s3 and r2: a folder in the bucket for the kits, such as "design-kits". Kits are <prefix>/<branch>/<sha>.zip with <prefix>/<branch>/latest.json.

region.description: s3: the bucket's AWS region, such as "us-east-1". Default: the aws CLI's own (AWS_REGION).

endpoint.description: s3: the endpoint of another S3-compatible store. Not needed for AWS S3, or for R2 (use type "r2").

accountId.description: r2: your Cloudflare account id (letters and digits). The endpoint https://<accountId>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com and region auto follow from it.

theme.description: How the app switches to its dark theme. Recorded in the kit's manifest, so `kit compose --theme dark` needs no config.

attribute.description: "class" (default) toggles a class; any other value is an attribute, such as "data-theme".

dark.description: The class or attribute value for dark. Default "dark".

light.description: The class or attribute value for light. Leave it out when light is the dark value's absence.

targets.description: The elements that carry the value. Default ["html", "body"] for a class, ["html"] for an attribute.

stories.description: `design-kit capture stories`: every story of a Storybook 7, 8 or 9 static build.

root.description: The Storybook project folder (where its .storybook folder is). Default ".".

storybookDir.description: An existing static build to capture. --storybook-dir overrides it.

buildCommand.description: Builds the static Storybook, run in `root`. `{out}` is replaced by a temporary folder when `staticDir` is not set.

staticDir.description: Where `buildCommand` writes the build (for example storybook-static).

viewport.description: Every story's first capture, unless it declares parameters.viewport.defaultViewport. Default 1280x800.

widths.description: More captures for stories whose title matches `titles`.

titles.description: A regular expression tested against the story's title, such as "^(Pages|Layout)/".

fonts.description: Faces every story is given. Without it, the @font-face files the Storybook build serves are copied into the kit.

dir.description: The folder that holds the font files.

file.description: A file name glob in `dir`, such as "inter-latin.*.woff2"; the first match in sorted order is used.

weight.description: The font-weight descriptor, such as "400" or "100 900".

variable.description: A CSS variable on :root set to this family, for apps that read their font from one.

fallback.description: The fallback list after the family in `variable`.

fixedTime.description: The instant every story reads from Date (ISO 8601). Default 2026-01-01T12:00:00.000Z.

gaps.description: Lists component files that no story covers in gaps.json.

componentGlob.description: Component files, as a glob relative to `root`, such as "src/**/[A-Z]*.tsx". Stories, tests and specs never count.

slots.description: Replaceable regions, by name: the first selector that matches a visible, non-empty element marks it with data-kit-slot. `main` is required.

name.description: The page's id in the kit: route:<name>@<width>.

ready.description: A Playwright selector that is visible once the page has rendered its content.

sourceFile.description: The page's source module, shown by `kit show` and searched by `kit find`.

layoutSlots.description: Slots for a layout the detector reports, replacing `slots` there.

pages.description: `design-kit capture pages`: real pages of the running app, through Playwright.

source.description: Names this page source (such as "web" or "terminal") so several apps capture into one kit: a capture then rewrites only its own source's frames, rows, stylesheet (css/routes--<source>.css) and gap rows. Page names must be unique across sources; a name another source already captured into the kit is a config error. Without it, a capture replaces every page in the kit.

baseUrl.description: The running app. Without it, `startCommand` starts the app and `waitUrl` says when it serves.

startCommand.description: Starts the app (run in `cwd`); it is stopped when the capture ends.

waitUrl.description: Polled until it answers; its origin is the base URL unless baseUrl is set.

cwd.description: Where `startCommand` runs. Default the config's folder.

startTimeoutMs.description: How long `waitUrl` may take to answer. Default 120000.

auth.description: Signs the browser in: a Playwright storageState file, or a setup module whose default export returns one.

hooks.description: A module exporting optional `context(context, info)` and `page(page, info)` hooks. `page` may return `{ beforeReady, readyFailed, beforeSerialize }`: `beforeReady()` runs after the shell shows and before the ready selector is awaited, for a page reached by a click.

widths.description: Every page is captured at each size. Default 1280x800 and 390x844.

fixedTime.description: The instant every page reads from Date (ISO 8601). Default 2026-01-01T12:00:00.000Z.

shellReady.description: A selector the app's frame shows before any page content.

layout.description: Reads the layout the app chose (an attribute of one element), which picks `layoutSlots`.

default.description: The layout when the attribute is absent. Default "default".

fontsPath.description: The app's font URL path, such as "/fonts/". Without it, any .woff2/.woff/.ttf/.otf URL is a font.

copyFonts.description: Copy the fonts the pages load into the kit's fonts folder. Default true.

timeoutMs.description: How long a page may take to show its ready selector. Default 30000.

forbidStrings.description: Values that must never reach the kit, such as a test account's token. A page whose output holds one, as written or escaped, is not written.
